glenwood-gardens: The operator says the completed first phase added sidewalk connections to Metro bus transit and a signalized crossing at Springfield Pike and Glendale-Milford Road. This source does not establish current bus frequency, stop boarding conditions or a measured continuous route through the gardens.
Phase 1 construction included new sidewalk connections to Metro bus transit and a signalized crosswalk to improve pedestrian and bicycle safety on Springfield Pike and Glendale-Milford Road.

The Glenwood Gardens–Winton Woods connection remains under construction. Phase 2 is intended to join the West Fork Mill Creek Greenway Trail at the Glenwood entrance to Winton Woods’ Harbor Loop; the tentative timetable runs through fall 2027 and may change. Do not plan on a completed through-route.
Construction is underway on the final phase of the Glenwood Gardens to Winton Woods Trail.
Phase 2 construction will complete the trail connection between the existing West Fork Mill Creek Greenway Trail at the entrance to Glenwood Gardens and the Harbor Loop Trail at Winton Woods.
Timeline is an estimate based on the current project status and is subject to change.
